payload.task_text:
I need to prepare a department budget presentation for our upcoming board meeting. Please pull the current department headcount and budget data from the company HR data warehouse and create a PowerPoint presentation called HR_Department_Overview.pptx. The presentation should have at least seven slides: a title slide called HR Department Budget Overview, one slide per department showing the department name, headcount, budget, and location, and a final summary slide showing total headcount and total budget across all departments. Use the department names exactly as they appear in the data source (for example `HR` and `R&D`) — do not expand or rephrase them.

After creating the presentation, also create an Excel file called Department_Budget_Analysis.xlsx with a sheet called Department Summary that has columns Department, Headcount, Budget rounded to 2 decimals, Location, and Budget_Per_Employee which is the budget divided by headcount rounded to 2 decimals, sorted alphabetically by department name. Add a second sheet called Summary with Metric and Value columns showing Total_Headcount, Total_Budget, Avg_Budget_Per_Employee (computed as Total_Budget divided by Total_Headcount) rounded to 2 decimals, and Highest_Budget_Dept. Use these exact metric labels (with underscores) as the Metric values.

Then create a Google Sheet named 'HR Department Tracker' (create it if it does not already exist) and populate it with the same department data, and send an email to hr.directors@company.com with subject HR Department Budget Summary Q1 2026 containing a brief overview of the findings.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent should first query the complete department table once, preserve exact department names such as HR and R&D, compute headcount and budget controls, and freeze alphabetically sorted rows. Then create the three independent deliverables in one wave.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 3 coder sub-agents in parallel:

   1. coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): One coder sub-agent owns `HR_Department_Overview.pptx` under one presentation ID. Use the literal source labels as slide text—especially the exact three-character string `R&D`; never expand it to Research and Development. Create the title slide, one slide per returned department with exact name/headcount/budget/location, and the final numeric summary. Use one bounded populate operation per slide, save once, extract the full deck text once, and return the path, slide count/titles, literal department-name coverage, and total checks.

   2. coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): One coder sub-agent owns `Department_Budget_Analysis.xlsx` and writes the exact Department Summary and Summary sheets with literal values, alphabetical rows, Budget_Per_Employee, and the exact underscore metric labels. Use one bulk write per sheet and one read-back.

   3. coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): One coder sub-agent owns exactly one `HR Department Tracker` cloud spreadsheet. Search the exact title, create only if absent, write the same literal source labels and rows once, and read it back once.

After Wave 1, the main agent checks that all three outputs contain every exact department label including `R&D` and that the totals agree, then sends exactly one email to `hr.directors@company.com` with subject `HR Department Budget Summary Q1 2026`. Do not run row-by-row revalidation or dispatch another wave.

Create a PowerPoint presentation file at exactly this path (create in the workspace):
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_Qwen3.8-Max/SingleUserTurn-sf-hr-dept-budget-ppt-email/workspace/HR_Department_Overview.pptx

This is a department budget presentation for a board meeting, built from data pulled from the company HR data warehouse. Use the pptx MCP tools (create_presentation, add_slide, manage_text, save_presentation, extract_presentation_text, etc.).

The deck must have exactly 9 slides in this order:

Slide 1 (title slide): Title text exactly "HR Department Budget Overview". You may add a small subtitle such as "Board Meeting – Q1 2026".

Slides 2–8: One slide per department, in this exact alphabetical order: Engineering, Finance, HR, Operations, R&D, Sales, Support. Each department slide must show the department name EXACTLY as written (do not rephrase or expand "HR" or "R&D") as the slide title, and the following body content with these exact numbers:

- Engineering: Headcount: 7096, Budget: $633,555,641.27, Location: New York
- Finance: Headcount: 7148, Budget: $616,980,984.11, Location: Sydney
- HR: Headcount: 7077, Budget: $697,911,374.65, Location: New York
- Operations: Headcount: 7120, Budget: $572,668,189.63, Location: Sydney
- R&D: Headcount: 7083, Budget: $715,914,847.42, Location: Singapore
- Sales: Headcount: 7232, Budget: $642,575,220.92, Location: New York
- Support: Headcount: 7244, Budget: $684,741,486.31, Location: Toronto

Slide 9 (final summary slide): Title "Summary". Body content:
- Total Headcount: 50,000
- Total Budget: $4,564,347,744.31
(You may optionally also include "Highest Budget Department: R&D".)

Requirements:
- Every department name must appear verbatim (especially "HR" and "R&D").
- Make the deck look professional (consistent design, readable fonts).
- After saving, verify by extracting all presentation text, and confirm the file exists at the exact path above.
- Report back: the exact file path, the number of slides, and the slide titles in order.

You have two external tasks, using the Google Sheet MCP tools and the email MCP tools.

Create or update a Google Spreadsheet named exactly "HR Department Tracker".

- If the first sheet has a generic name like "Sheet1", you may rename it to "Department Data" (optional, not required).

TASK 2 — Email:
Send an email with these exact fields:
- To: hr.directors@company.com
- Subject: HR Department Budget Summary Q1 2026
- Body: a brief overview of the findings from the HR department budget analysis. Include at minimum:
  - Data source: HR department table in the company HR data warehouse
  - 7 departments: Engineering, Finance, HR, Operations, R&D, Sales, Support
  - Total Headcount: 50,000
  - Total Budget: $4,564,347,744.31
  - Average Budget per Employee: $91,286.95
  - Highest budget department: R&D ($715,914,847.42)
  - A short per-department breakdown (department, headcount, budget, location) using the numbers from Task 1
  - Mention that a board presentation (HR_Department_Overview.pptx) and an analysis workbook (Department_Budget_Analysis.xlsx) were prepared, and the "HR Department Tracker" Google Sheet has been populated.
  Keep the tone professional and concise.

Use send_email (not a draft). Verify the send was reported successful.

Report back: the spreadsheet ID/URL and whether it was newly created or existing, the verified data read-back, and the email send result.
